name: healthaccess
description: HealthAccess monorepo: online portal and API, offline SMS/USSD, shared patient-access core

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:online && npm run build:offline
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @healthaccess/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @healthaccess/online && npm run typecheck --workspace @healthaccess/offline
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @healthaccess/shared && npm run test --workspace @healthaccess/online && npm run test --workspace @healthaccess/offline
